_doc: icons = every id that must exist (family, motif, size S|M|L, draw kit|batch, optional alias_of / state:ud / also); aliases = legacy i-* ids; map = emoji code point -> default icon id (becomes Z.ICO); keep = code points left as text; drop = code points removed (instead = replacement ids); by = data key -> icon id tables for data-driven sites (Z.Icons.by). Hand-edited JSON, validated by scripts/build-icons.js.

by._doc: Data-driven sites: the emoji stays in data.js; look the icon up by the data key instead of Z.ico(emoji). Z.Icons.by exposes this table at runtime.
